messages:
Nina (CSM): Heads-up: ClearLeaf usage dropped ~72% this week after their embedded-features were disabled. Champion left last Friday; procurement just asked for a competitor quote. Renewal ~6w. Need rapid triage.

Ravi (AE): Yikes. Can we tell if calls stopped due to errors or product change?

Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick check  no 5xx spike, p50 latency steady. It's fewer requests from client. Likely toggled off background embeds.

Nina (CSM): Their PM confirmed they flipped a cost-saver flag. That removed two key UX flows.

Ravi (AE): Proposed play: 1) 30m recovery call with PM+eng this week. 2) 8-week credit package conditional on MAU recovery. 3) 30m enablement for new champion. Thoughts?

Ben (RevOps): Credits need KPI tie (e.g., return to >=80% baseline MAU in 6 weeks) + clawback clause. I can draft terms.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick remediations: re-enable sampled prefetch (20%), raise client batch_size 4->12, set embed cache TTL 24h. Example snippet I can share on the call.

Nina (CSM): I'll book the call and include an ROI snapshot showing feature impact. Ravi, loop legal if procurement presses on pricing.

OpsBot: Reminder  ClearLeaf renewal due 2026-05-15 (6w).

Ravi (AE): Flagging P1 renewal-risk. If procurement sends a competitor number, paste here and I'll craft a counter.

Nina (CSM): Thanks. Will update after the call. If anyone hears from procurement earlier, drop it here. :pray:
